labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for a new SpeedColumn progress column, i.e. new behaviour/API.

body:
Next step: new features need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please post this proposal there.

Some of this already works. `TaskProgressColumn(show_speed=True)` shows speed when `total` is unknown, and a custom column can render `task.speed` with your own unit by subclassing [`ProgressColumn`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py).

Related earlier issue: #3835.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
